notes: M4 heat-set inserts; bolts the cheek to the turntable plate, 4 walls, 40% infill.

Azimuth gear: module 1.5, 150 teeth on the full circle (pitch radius 112.5 mm), 80 deg cut. Bolts under the turntable plate (3 x M4 into heat-set inserts); meshes with the stepper's 15-tooth pinion. Print flat, 100% infill, 0.1 mm layers for the flanks; grease the teeth.
Sockets a 25 mm vertical pole 40 mm deep; M5 screws and T-nuts into the beam. 6 walls.
Joins a vertical pole to the top pole; sockets 40 mm deep. 6 walls, 40% gyroid.
Clips the top pole and holds the 2020 stereo bar; add an M4 clamp screw each. 6 walls.
Floor of the ball path between the head plates; the shuttle slides on it. M4 heat-set inserts take screws through both head plates.
Roof over the shuttle, a column 70 mm bore up past the head plates, and a hose socket (82.5 mm) on top. Print upright, 6 walls.

Pocket for one ball (70 mm hole); the front is narrowed to 58 mm between two 1.6 mm flexure arms that hold the ball at negative elevation and let the wheels pull it out; the solid rear shuts the column while it moves 95 mm forward. Drawn retracted (pocket under the column). M4 heat-set insert in the +y side 20 mm ahead of the rear end takes the drive pin. 6 walls.
Shuttle pin to crank pin, 120 mm between 5.4 mm holes; M4 shoulder bolts (5 mm shoulder) through both. Print flat, 100% infill.

Crank, 47.5 mm throw (95 mm stroke over 180 deg of servo turn); screw it to the servo's round aluminium horn (M3 through the centre hole and two of the horn's own holes, drilled to suit). Print flat, 100% infill.

Holds the shuttle servo by its tabs outboard of the motor plate; three legs take M4 screws through the plate into heat-set inserts, and two more inserts take the servo's tab screws. Print cradle face down.

Azimuth home switch bracket on the mast plate, 45 deg round from the front. Two M3 screws through its radial slots (1.5 mm either way) into the mast plate; set it so the switch clicks with the roller in the middle of the gear sector's cam lobe. M2 pilots 6.5 mm apart for the switch: check against yours. 100% infill.

Azimuth hard stops, one each side, on the mast plate in the gap the gear sector turns in. The sector's end faces meet their pads at +-35 deg (working range +-30, home click -32). Two M4 heat-set inserts from below; screws up through the mast plate. 100% infill. Glue a 5 mm polyurethane pad on the face toward the sector.
Sleeve socket under the shelf's outlet hole: flange on the sloped shelf (M4 heat-set inserts), a vertical cup 102.5 mm across and 40 mm deep for the sleeve's top end. Print flange down, 6 walls.

Bond the hose's top end 25 mm into the socket. The funnel narrows 88 to 72 mm so a ball dropping down the sleeve cannot catch the hose's rim. The tab through the sleeve's slot takes the spring's band and keeps the collar from turning. Print funnel up, 6 walls.
